cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.
